decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, where walls are being knocked through on the ground floor, the wall nibs shown for retention should be retained at a depth of 0.25m (internal walls) and 0.33m (external walls); the downstand beam above the internal wall to be removed shall be retained to a depth of 0.15m.

Condition : 5 - Before construction of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted is commenced, details of the structure's alignments, flashing, glazing and supports should be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and then implemented on site in accordance with these details.

Condition : 6 - Before the removal of the paint from the external brickwork is commenced, a small sample area shall be completed to the Council's satisfaction and details submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and the works then carried out in accordance with the approved process.

Condition : 7 - Before the re pointing of the external brickwork is commenced, a small sample area shall be completed to the Council's satisfaction, with no damage to the bricks,  and details submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and the works then carried out in accordance with the approved process.
description: Demolition of existing garage, shed & outbuilding to House (Listed Building Consent)
